verdict.rationale: The evidence documents logs shown in the AI Gateway dashboard, per-request logging control headers, and a patchLog method for feedback and metadata. None of it documents exporting logs or traces to an external observability stack, such as a log push destination, OpenTelemetry export, or a log export API. The marketing line about building monitoring systems from logging data names no export mechanism, so it does not count as delivering the story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack
